# barndoor_policy_revisions (Data Source)

Lists the revision history of the policies that govern an MCP server, newest first — who changed what, and when. The data source follows the API's pagination to the end, so `revisions` holds every matching revision; use `since` to bound a long history. The list is scoped to the organization the provider credential belongs to. Requires a Barndoor platform release that includes the `/api/policy/v2/policy-revisions` endpoint.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look up an MCP server, then list its policy revision history (newest first).
data "barndoor_mcp_server" "github" {
  slug = "github"
}

data "barndoor_policy_revisions" "github" {
  mcp_server_id = data.barndoor_mcp_server.github.id

  # Optional: only revisions made at or after this instant (RFC 3339).
  since = "2026-09-01T00:00:00Z"
}

output "latest_change_summary" {
  value = try(data.barndoor_policy_revisions.github.revisions[0].changes_summary, [])
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `mcp_server_id` (String) UUID of the MCP server whose policy revisions to list.

### Optional

- `since` (String) Only return revisions made at or after this instant (inclusive), as an RFC 3339 timestamp such as `2026-09-01T00:00:00Z`. Values with a UTC offset are converted to UTC before they are sent. Omit to list the full history.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Identifier of the data source; equal to `mcp_server_id`.
- `revisions` (Attributes List) The policy revisions, newest first (the API's order is preserved). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--revisions))

<a id="nestedatt--revisions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `revisions`

Read-Only:

- `categories` (List of String) Categories of change the revision touched (an empty list when the API reports none).
- `changes_json` (String) The revision's full `changes` object as compact JSON. Decode it with `jsondecode()`; its shape depends on what changed and is not a stable contract, so prefer `changes_summary` for display.
- `changes_summary` (List of String) Human-readable one-line summaries of the changes in the revision (an empty list when the API reports none).
- `id` (String) UUID of the revision.
- `policy_id` (String) UUID of the policy that was revised.
- `revised_at` (String) When the revision was made, as an RFC 3339 timestamp in UTC (for example `2026-09-28T18:10:24.830776Z`).
- `revised_by` (String) Identifier of the principal that made the revision.
- `revised_by_name` (String) Display name of the principal that made the revision; null when the API has none.
- `triggered_by` (String) Identifier of the principal or system event that triggered the revision, when it was not a direct edit; null otherwise.
- `triggered_by_name` (String) Display name of the principal or system event that triggered the revision; null when the API has none.
- `version_number` (Number) Sequential version number of the policy after this revision.
